description: This PHP file defines the Compare class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the Engineering calculations namespace. It provides two static functions, DELTA and GESTEP, which implement Excel functions related to comparisons of numeric values, including array handling, validation, and threshold logic.

classes.name: Compare
classes.description: A class implementing comparison functions DELTA and GESTEP for use within the PhpSpreadsheet Engineering calculations namespace.

methods.name: DELTA
methods.description: Tests whether two values are equal within a small tolerance, akin to the Kronecker Delta. Supports array inputs and returns corresponding arrays or single value.

methods.name: GESTEP
methods.description: Returns 1 if the first number is greater than or equal to the step; otherwise 0. Supports array inputs.
